title: Grok image-generation misuse and EU response
summary: Image-editing features on Grok, built into X, were used from late December 2025 to create non-consensual sexualised edits of real people, including minors. The European Commission opened DSA proceedings on 26 January 2026.
caution: The onset date is the start of a documented analysis window of mass misuse; sources differ on the exact start, so day counts are approximate.
regional_note: EU-level action: the Commission's DSA proceedings (IP/26/203) opened 26 January 2026; the Irish DPC had already concluded separate Grok training proceedings in September 2024.
